question: _________’s ‘The Year of the Runaways’ follows the lives of three migrant workers who flee India to look for work in England.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sunjeev Sahota**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Year of the Runaways**

 
 
• 'The Year of the Runaways is **Sunjeev Sahota's second book**, and he is a **British novelist**. 
 
• After being **released in June 2015, it was shortlisted for the 2015 Man Booker Prize** and received the **2017 European Union Prize for Literature (for the UK)**.
 
• The book follows the **lives of three migrant workers who flee India to look for work in England**.
 
• The plot of the book **centres on the interactions between three young men and one woman over the period of four seasons**, during which their aspirations, physical capabilities, and religious beliefs are tested.
 
• The Year of the Runaways was ranked among the **top 12 Indian novels by Emma Lee-Potter of The Independent in 2020**. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Ours are the Streets' is Sahota's first book** which was released by Picador in **January 2011**. 
 
• A **British Pakistani youngster who becomes a suicide bomber **is the **subject of the book**.
